title: Drivers: the model you have, on its own wire
description: How PanCode shapes each request for its provider wire, names the cause of a cache break, and an experiment to measure the saving.
question: Does shaping each request for its provider wire reduce the fresh input a session pays for, and by how much on each model lineage?
author: Anthony Kougkas
basis: Read from source; first experiment not yet run
status: In the release. Not yet measured.

title: Memory: context as a priced storage tier
description: How PanCode tiers the context window, prices an eviction against the prompt cache, and recalls evicted output exactly, with a first experiment.
question: Does pricing an eviction against the provider's cache beat evicting by age on a long task?
author: Anthony Kougkas
basis: Read from source; first experiment not yet run
status: In the release. Not yet measured.

title: Scheduling: a mixed fleet under one policy
description: How PanCode admits, bounds, and grades its workers and other coding agents, with a first experiment against a single agent.
question: Does a graded fleet finish more work per token than one agent on the same tasks?
author: Anthony Kougkas
basis: Read from source; first experiment not yet run
status: In the release. Not yet measured.

title: Protection: a floor at every autonomy level
description: How PanCode decides each call: a fixed floor, containment, a judge that never reads model text, and flow rules, with a first experiment.
question: How many approval cards can containment and a judge remove without admitting a call you would have refused?
author: Anthony Kougkas
basis: Read from source; first experiment not yet run
status: In the release. Not yet measured.

question: How often does a model declare a task done when the evidence does not support it, and how often does the host catch it?
author: Anthony Kougkas
basis: Read from source; first experiment not yet run
status: In the release. Not yet measured.
